## Scaffold split
- Murcko scaffolds without chirality; 13 acyclic compounds each given a unique pseudo-scaffold id; greedy packing by compound count.
- Counts: train 340, val 72, test 74.

## Statistical power
- Scaffold test set: 74 compounds, 12 safe (prevalence 0.8378).
- Random-classifier AUC-PR 95% bootstrap interval on this test set: [0.726, 0.944].

## Name matches rejected for a molecular-formula mismatch
